qualitative.filing_summary_10k: For fiscal year 2025, Monolithic Power Systems reported revenue of $2.79 billion, up 26.4% from $2.21 billion in 2024, with growth across all end markets led by storage and computing and automotive; gross margin was 55.2%, roughly flat versus 2024. The filing discloses a restatement of the 2024 annual financial statements and 2025 quarterly financial statements due to an error in accounting for deferred income taxes tied to a foreign tax incentive, and management concluded internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of December 31, 2025 due to a related material weakness. The company also notes a $3.6 billion valuation allowance against certain deferred tax assets and describes ongoing macroeconomic, tariff, and litigation risks.
qualitative.filing_summary_10q: The 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 shows revenue of $980.6 million for the quarter, up from $664.6 million a year earlier, and six-month revenue of $1.78 billion versus $1.30 billion in the prior-year period. Total assets grew to $4.69 billion from $4.19 billion at December 31, 2025, with increases in cash and short-term investments, receivables, and inventories, and stockholders' equity rose to $3.90 billion. The excerpt provided is limited to financial statement data and does not include the narrative MD&A discussion.
qualitative.filing_summary_8k: This 8-K, dated September 10, 2026, discloses that the company issued a press release announcing a third-quarter cash dividend of $2.00 per share, payable to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026, with payment on October 15, 2026. No other items are reported in this filing.
qualitative.moat_explanation: The 10-K describes a large portfolio of proprietary process and packaging technologies (2,231 patents/applications, 654 issued in the U.S.) combined with trade-secret-protected manufacturing processes and deep, hard-to-replicate analog/mixed-signal design expertise developed since 1997. The company states these technologies let it differentiate products on integration, efficiency, and size versus larger, better-resourced competitors, though it also acknowledges it does not rely on any single patent and faces intense competition from many larger rivals.
red_flags: Material weakness in internal control over financial reporting related to accounting for deferred income taxes, effective as of December 31, 2024 and 2025
Restatement of 2024 annual financial statements and 2025 quarterly financial statements due to the deferred tax error
High customer concentration: three distributors accounted for 26%, 18% and 10% of 2025 total revenue
Heavy geographic concentration, with 92% of 2025 revenue from customers in Asia
Ongoing patent infringement litigation risk described as characteristic of the industry, with potential for costly litigation or required royalty payments
Dependence on key personnel, including founder/CEO Michael Hsing, for proprietary process technology and continued innovation
